# Visual styles

Ten visual directions. Each file covers concept, target industries, palette, typography, layout, photography, graphic elements and UI, social and website examples.

| # | Style | In one line | Best for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 01 | [Quiet Luxury](./01-quiet-luxury.md) | Restraint as the signal of value. | Fine jewelry and watches, Fashion and leather goods, Premium real estate |
| 02 | [Swiss Precision](./02-swiss-precision.md) | Clarity built on a visible grid. | Consulting and advisory, Banking and fintech (B2B), Law firms |
| 03 | [Neo-Brutalism](./03-neo-brutalism.md) | Loud, honest, and a little unfinished. | Tech startups and productivity apps, Creator economy and education, Streetwear and youth brands |
| 04 | [Organic Earth](./04-organic-earth.md) | Grown, not manufactured. | Natural skincare and wellness, Organic food and beverage, Sustainable home goods |
| 05 | [Future Tech](./05-future-tech.md) | Light from a dark screen. | SaaS and AI products, Fintech and crypto, Cybersecurity |
| 06 | [Bold Editorial](./06-bold-editorial.md) | Every page is a cover. | Media and publishing, Fashion and luxury retail campaigns, Museums, galleries and culture |
| 07 | [Playful Pop](./07-playful-pop.md) | Bright, round and instantly likeable. | Food, desserts and cafés, FMCG snacks and beverages, Kids and family brands |
| 08 | [Clinical Clarity](./08-clinical-clarity.md) | Calm, clear and easy to trust. | Hospitals and clinics, Pharma and medical devices, Health insurance |
| 09 | [Modern Heritage](./09-modern-heritage.md) | Tradition, drawn with a modern hand. | Hospitality, cafés and restaurants, Ramadan and Eid campaigns, Cultural institutions and heritage tourism |
| 10 | [Kinetic Sport](./10-kinetic-sport.md) | Built to move. | Sportswear and sneakers, Gyms, fitness studios and clubs, Energy and sports drinks |

- `tokens.css`: every style's tokens as CSS custom properties, scoped by `[data-style="…"]`.
- `tokens.json`: the same tokens in the W3C Design Tokens format, keyed by style ID.

All sample brands in these files are fictional and exist only to demonstrate the styles.
